crossRefs.note: This poor man cried, and Yahweh heard him, and saved him out of all his troubles.
My cry goes to God! Indeed, I cry to God for help, and for him to listen to me.
In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord. My hand was stretched out in the night, and didn’t get tired. My soul…
Out of the depths I have cried to you, Yahweh.
Lord, hear my voice. Let your ears be attentive to the voice of my petitions.
For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same…
to another faith, by the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, by the same Spirit;
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to…
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.

translations.web: I cried to you, Yahweh. I made supplication to the Lord:
translations.bsb: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:
translations.kjv: I cried to thee, O LORD; and unto the LORD I made supplication.
translations.asv: I cried to thee, O Jehovah; And unto Jehovah I made supplication:
